sources.title: SFU Statement of Financial Information 2017/18: employee remuneration and expenses
sources.scopeDescription: Complete named employee schedule, earnings greater than or equal to $75,000; separate board schedule and aggregate rows excluded

validation.independentMethod: PyMuPDF positioned words compared cell-for-cell with Poppler pdftotext -bbox-layout words; all page/column name groups and money anchors assigned; complete multiplicity retained. Both engines independently read the published controls.
validation.approvalRepresentation: Visible signature on published approval page
validation.visualReview: Rendered published originals reviewed for source approval, table scope, first/final or control rows, and representative wrapped-name/negative-expense boundaries. Additional complete extraction checks cover every named cell in both PDF readers.

notes: The complete named employee schedule is imported; the separate Board of Governors schedule, suppliers, below-threshold aggregate and grand totals are excluded. Job titles are not published and remain missing.

Names retain the original disclosure, including initials in 2017/18–2019/20 and repeated names as separate observations. No cross-year identity inference is made. Same-period compiled employee partitions for 2017/18 and 2020/21 are replaced by complete official fiscal sources; the original compiled evidence is retained separately.
Blank/dash expense cells remain missing. Numeric zeroes and negative amounts are retained. Published remuneration is an annual payment disclosure, not a base annual salary.
Wrapped names are joined within the same cell; a line ending in a literal hyphen is joined to its continuation without an inserted space. Names can wrap before or after the remuneration baseline.

The retained compilation gives different names for three matching payment cells: official 'Schmidt, Michele' ($119,776 pay, $4,725 expenses) versus compiled 'Schmidt, Gina'; official 'Schmidt, G' ($81,003, $6,570) versus compiled 'Schmidt, Margaret'; official 'Schmidt, Margaret' ($132,061, $811) versus compiled 'Schmidt, Michele'. The official report is reproduced as published; the names and compiled job titles have not been reconciled.
sources.publicWarning: The retained compilation gives different names for three matching payment cells: official 'Schmidt, Michele' ($119,776 pay, $4,725 expenses) versus compiled 'Schmidt, Gina'; official 'Schmidt, G' ($81,003, $6,570) versus compiled 'Schmidt, Margaret'; official 'Schmidt, Margaret' ($132,061, $811) versus compiled 'Schmidt, Michele'. The official report is reproduced as published; the names and compiled job titles have not been reconciled.
